events.detail: Remote HEAD 765472fd39a3187789780a3eeb3c4348821ee80a, checkpoint sequence 39, queued slot state and Wave 34 metrics were re-read.
The canonical Automation 167 acceptance truth path remained absent; no completion, product promotion or percent-100 claim was made.
Current SDL and Auction House London, South West and East Anglia first-party pages were screened for development, conversion and planning records.
Auction date, guide, tenure, area, planning reference, listed status, application state and current marketing status were read from eighteen direct pages.
Eighteen selected titles and references were searched against the repository before write and no prior candidate rows were returned.

Eighteen unique research candidates and eighteen direct first-party source upgrades were prepared with no duplicate rewrite and no product promotion.
Wave 35 data, web, report, progress, status and checkpoint artifacts were prepared with all safety flags preserved.
